turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of budget used (nor for the total budget), so I can't give that percentage; the closest metrics are remaining budget and ad spend. For 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, the remaining budget at month end was 4,130.00 EUR (Remaining budget, EUR) and ad spend was 6,270.00 EUR (Ad spend, EUR). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
